Day 23: Today, I found a crust so bad it made me reconsider bread. Derek stood in a line with pigeons, which is not how lines are formed. At De Turk, I found a teaspoon of salt shaped like a question mark, and the baklava crumbs formed a sentence I did not eat. Derek preened at the fountain, and I said nothing.
